sentence: This project studies how alcohol use during adolescence in rats changes sleep and activity rhythms and later drinking.
This project tries to improve cancer research in Zambia, where HIV-associated cancers have become more common.
This project builds injectable scaffolds that release metformin to help stem cells regrow craniofacial bone.
This project repeats earlier gene editing tests in juvenile cynomolgus monkeys to check they can treat phenylketonuria.
This project studies how the thalamocortical pathway forms in humans and how genetic mutations may disrupt it, using human stem cells.
This project builds a deep learning tool that finds the choroid plexus in neuroimaging data and tracks how it changes across the lifespan.
This project studies how hypoxia rescues mitochondrial mutants by solving the structures of electron transport chain complexes.
This project builds tools to watch transcription, translation and chromatin modifications in living cells to learn how gene expression is regulated.
This project creates a kit that enriches rare astrocyte nuclei from frozen Alzheimer's brain tissue and reads their transcriptomes and chromatin landscapes.
This project tries to find out what instructions guide hematopoietic stem cells to form during development, so they can be made in the laboratory.
This project tests a treatment for children and young adults whose B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia relapses after chimeric antigen receptor T-cell therapy.
This project tries to find out how redox balance sets the pace of embryonic development in different species.
This project studies how Leishmania parasites persist in infected people by looking at the transcriptomes, metabolomes and immunophenotypes of host tissues and cells.
This project builds human gut microbiome communities from the bottom-up and uses computational models and germ-free mouse models to understand their interaction networks.
This project compares how two types of heterochromatin control whether transcription factors and pioneer factors can bind the same gene regulatory sequences.
This project studies how different exercise protocols, alone or with nutritional approaches, affect cartilage integrity with aging and by sex in knee osteoarthritis.
This project uses multi-modal MRI to measure the glymphatic system and how it changes with aging, preclinical Alzheimer's disease and aerobic exercise.
This project builds and tests a mobile intervention to increase sun protection and skin self-examination behaviors among Hispanic individuals.
This project studies how infection and high-fat diet-induced obesity give hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells with clonal hematopoiesis mutations an advantage and lead to malignancy.
This project uses fish models and large-scale genetic screens to find the genetic programs that control how retinal stem cells regenerate retinal cells.
